translationRepairs: On xinhai Kong Xun of Heyang retired as grand preceptor.
On xinhai Kong, former Heyang military commissioner, Grand Guardian by inspection, and concurrent Attendant-in-Chief, retired as grand preceptor to the heir apparent.
The Chinese names only 孔, so the invented given name Xun is an error, and 太子太師 is grand preceptor to the heir apparent; the proposal still omits 檢校太傅 and 兼侍中.
On xinyou Mao Zhang became right gold spears senior general, Hua Wenqi right gold spears grand general, and Zhang Qianzhao Zheng defense commissioner.
On xinyou Mao Zhang became right gold spears senior general, Hua Wenqi right gold spears grand general, and Zhang Qianzhao Zhengzhou defense commissioner.
張虔釗為鄭州防禦使 makes Zhengzhou the posting, not part of the name; inserting Zhengzhou repairs the fusion.
On jiaxu Lady Cao became Shufei and Lady Wang Defei, with enfeoffment days to be set.
On jiaxu Lady Cao became Shufei and Lady Wang became Defei, with investiture days to be set.
Chinese treats 王氏 and 德妃 as person plus title; Lady Wang Defei fuses them, and 冊命 is investiture rather than enfeoffment.
On dinghai Guo Chengfeng of Tiande received inspector grand guardian.
On dinghai Guo Chengfeng of Tiande received Inspector-in-Chief of Works.
檢校司徒 is Inspector-in-Chief of Works, not Grand Guardian (太保).
On dingsi Wang Jingzhan became Hua commissioner and Li Congwen Xing commissioner.
On dingsi Wang Jingzhan became Hua commissioner and Li Congwen became Xing commissioner.
李從溫為邢州節度使; without became, Li Congwen Xing reads as a fused personal name.
On gengshen, former Fu prefecture military commissioner Zhai Zhang was made Xinzhou Weisai Army regent.
On gengshen, former Fu prefecture prefect Zhai Zhang was made Xinzhou Weisai Army regent.
前復州刺史 is former prefect, not military commissioner.
Former Zheng prefecture military commissioner Yang Hanbin was made Yangzhou Wuding Army regent.
Former Zheng prefecture prefect Yang Hanbin was made Yangzhou Wuding Army regent.
前鄭州刺史 is former prefect, not military commissioner.

On wuchen Chen Gao became Feng Wuxing regent, Sun Hanzhao Ying Zhangguo regent, Fan Yanguang privy commissioner, Zhang Yanlang southern privy commissioner, Lou Jiying Yao training commissioner, and Zhang Tingyun Jin defense commissioner.

On wuchen Chen Gao became Feng Wuxing regent, Sun Hanzhao became Ying Zhangguo regent, Fan Yanguang privy commissioner, Zhang Yanlang southern privy commissioner, Lou Jiying became Yao training commissioner, and Zhang Tingyun became Jin defense commissioner.
Sun Hanzhao Ying, Lou Jiying Yao, and Zhang Tingyun Jin fuse persons with postings; inserting became separates them as in 孫漢韶為應州彰國軍留後 and the parallel 為 clauses.
A Taibai Mountain Daoist, Jie Yuan'gui, came from Sichuan, met Mingzong informally, and claimed to be 111.
A Taibai Mountain Daoist, Jie Yuan'gui, came from Sichuan, met Mingzong informally, and claimed to be 101.
稱年一百一歲 is one hundred one, not one hundred eleven.
At the time the Taibai Mountain Daoist Jie Yuan'gui came from Sichuan, was received in the informal hall, and claimed to be one hundred eleven years old.
At the time the Taibai Mountain Daoist Jie Yuan'gui came from Sichuan, was received in the informal hall, and claimed to be one hundred one years old.
稱年一百一歲 is one hundred one, not one hundred eleven.
On jiashen Princess Yongning was enfeoffed to Lady Shi and Princess Xingping to Lady Zhao, with enfeoffment days to be set.
On jiashen the Emperor's third daughter Lady Shi was enfeoffed Princess Yongning and the thirteenth daughter Lady Zhao Princess Xingping, with enfeoffment days to be set.
皇第三女石氏封永寧公主 confers the princess title on the emperor's daughter, the reverse of enfeoffing the princess to Lady Shi.
On renyin Wang Yanqiu reported attacking the rebel city on the twenty-second of the sixth month with three thousand wounded.
On jiayin Wang Yanqiu reported attacking the rebel city on the twenty-second of the sixth month with three thousand wounded.
The date graph is 甲寅 (jiayin), which follows 壬子, not 壬寅 (renyin).
On renyin Wang Yanqiu reported that on the twenty-second of the sixth month he attacked the rebel city; three thousand officers and men were wounded.
On jiayin Wang Yanqiu reported that on the twenty-second of the sixth month he attacked the rebel city; three thousand officers and men were wounded.
The date graph is 甲寅 (jiayin), not 壬寅 (renyin).
On guimao court mourned Crown Prince junior tutor Li Maoxun.
On yimao court mourned Crown Prince Junior Guardian Li Maoxun.
乙卯 is yimao, not guimao, and 太子少保 is Junior Guardian, not junior tutor.
On guimao court was suspended for mourning because Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Maoxun died.
On yimao court was suspended for mourning because Crown Prince Junior Guardian Li Maoxun died.
乙卯 is yimao and 太子少保 is Junior Guardian, not Junior Tutor.

On the guiyou new moon of the eighth month Li Yun and Liu Xu, Hanlin academicians, became revenue vice ministers; Liu Yue of Personnel acted as library director; Han Yanhun of Personnel as rites minister; Gui Ai of Revenue as crown prince guest; Pei Hao of Revenue as war vice minister; Zhang Wenbao as punishments vice minister.

On the guiyou new moon of the eighth month Li Yi and Liu Xu, Hanlin academicians, became revenue vice ministers; Liu Yue of Personnel acted as library director; Han Yanhun of Personnel as rites minister; Gui Ai of Revenue as crown prince guest; Pei Hao of Revenue as war vice minister; Zhang Wenbao as punishments vice minister.
李懌 transcribes as Li Yi; Yun is the wrong reading of 懌.

Eighth month, guiyou new moon: Hanlin academician and acting Secretariat drafting officer Li Yun and Liu Xu were both made Vice Ministers of Revenue in office; Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Yue acted as Director of the Imperial Library; Vice Minister of Personnel Han Yanhun acted as Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Revenue Gui Ai acted as Crown Prince Guest; Vice Minister of Revenue Pei Hao acted as Vice Minister of War; Secretariat drafting officer Zhang Wenbao acted as Vice Minister of Punishments.

Eighth month, guiyou new moon: Hanlin academician and acting Secretariat drafting officer Li Yi and Liu Xu were both made Vice Ministers of Revenue in office; Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Yue acted as Director of the Imperial Library; Vice Minister of Personnel Han Yanhun acted as Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Revenue Gui Ai acted as Crown Prince Guest; Vice Minister of Revenue Pei Hao acted as Vice Minister of War; Secretariat drafting officer Zhang Wenbao acted as Vice Minister of Punishments.
李懌 transcribes as Li Yi, not Li Yun.
On xinmao Han Pu, Shuofang acting commissioner, became Shuofang commissioner, Lingwu-Gansu surveillance commissioner, and honorary Minister of Works.
On xinmao Han Pu, Shuofang acting commissioner, became Shuofang commissioner, surveillance commissioner of Lingwu, Xiong, Jing, Gansu, and other prefectures, and honorary Minister of Works.
靈武雄警甘肅等州 lists the prefectures Lingwu, Xiong, Jing, and Gansu; 雄 and 警 are not adjectives.

On xinmao Shuofang army acting commissioner Han Pu was made Shuofang army military commissioner, Lingwu martial-alert Gansu and other prefectures surveillance commissioner, and honorary Minister of Works.

On xinmao Shuofang army acting commissioner Han Pu was made Shuofang army military commissioner, surveillance commissioner of Lingwu, Xiong, Jing, Gansu, and other prefectures, and honorary Minister of Works.
雄警 are the prefectures Xiong and Jing, not martial-alert.
On wushen Zhao Dejun presented captives; Tiyin and fifty barbarian generals joined the personal guard; six hundred other Khitan were beheaded.
On wushen Zhao Dejun presented captives; the barbarian general Tiyin and others, fifty in all, were kept in the personal guard; six hundred other Khitan were beheaded.
蕃將惕隱等五十人 is fifty men including Tiyin; the original adds fifty extra generals, but the proposal's and fifty others still reads as Tiyin plus fifty.
Wen Wei of Xiangyi did not avenge his father's killer though a settlement petition existed; a special edict ordered execution.
Wen Wei of Xiangyi, whose father had been killed by someone, did not avenge his father; though there was a petition to settle, a special edict ordered execution.
父為人所殺，不雪父冤 makes the father the victim to be avenged; avenge his father's killer reverses patient and agent, and 有狀和解 is a settlement petition.
Winter, tenth month, jiachen: Princess Qionghua of the Chang clan, née Meng, may be enfeoffed as Princess of Fuqing.
Winter, tenth month, jiachen: Grand Princess Qionghua, née Meng, may be invested as Grand Princess Fuqing.
瓊華長公主 is the rank Grand Princess, not a Chang clan; 孟氏 is née Meng, and 冊為福慶長公主 is investiture as Grand Princess Fuqing.
On jiazi Gao Xinggui of An reported Left Divine Swift and Left Huaihun garrison mutiny driven out and killed beyond the walls.
On jiazi Gao Xinggui of An reported Left Divine Swift and Left Huaishun garrison mutiny driven out and killed beyond the walls.
左懷順 transcribes as Huaishun, not Huaihun.
That day Zhang Xichong—Khitan-appointed at Ping, grand guardian and grand preceptor by inspection—became Ru prefect and grand tutor by inspection.
That day Zhang Xichong—Khitan-appointed Pingzhou prefect, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and acting Grand Guardian—became Ruzhou prefect and was additionally acting Grand Tutor.
The Chinese lists 平州刺史、光祿大夫、檢校太保, then appointment as 汝州刺史 with 加檢校太傅; the original omits 光祿大夫 and conflates 太保 with Grand Preceptor.
On jiawu Wang Jianli—left vice director, councilor, Hall of Assembled Worthies director, and Three Bureaus commissioner—became Qing commissioner, grand preceptor by inspection, and councilor.
On jiawu Wang Jianli—left vice director, councilor, Hall of Assembled Worthies director, and Three Bureaus commissioner—became Qing commissioner, acting Grand Commandant, and councilor.
檢校太尉 is acting Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor (太師).
Mingzong said: "Only he, Guo Chongtao, and Li Jilin had received them from the prior reign—and Chongtao and Jilin were soon wiped out; his own peril might come any day."
Mingzong said: "Only I, Guo Chongtao, and Li Jilin had received them from the prior reign—and Chongtao and Jilin were soon wiped out; my own peril might come any day."
惟朕 is Mingzong speaking in the first person; he and his misattribute the speaker.
